articles.summary: Trinamool Congress national general secretary and Member of Parliament Abhishek Banerjee visited the Bhowanipur police station in Kolkata on November 14, 2026, for police questioning. The questioning relates to a first information report registered on May 27 following a complaint alleging that his social media post during the assembly election period targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis. The politician faces an additional summons from the Girish Park police station scheduled for November 20.
articles.description: An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period

articles.headline: Doctor arrested for allegedly harassing house surgeon in Nedumangad
articles.title: Doctor held for ‘sexually harassing’ house surgeon in Keralam
articles.summary: Police took a government doctor into custody following allegations that he made sexual advances toward a postgraduate house surgeon at Nedumangad Government Taluk Hospital. Keralam Health Minister K Muraleedharan stated that strict disciplinary measures will be implemented against the accused. The arrest occurred at the suspect residence following the recording of the victim detailed statement and subsequent protests by workers.
articles.description: Health Minister promises action in the incident

articles.headline: TRAI bars over 1.24 lakh mobile connections in spam crackdown
articles.title: TRAI crackdown on spam: Over 1.24 lakh mobile connections barred or disconnected in July-September
articles.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India enforced punitive measures against more than 1.24 lakh telecom resources and blacklisted 374 entities during the July-September period to combat unsolicited commercial communications. Officials reported receiving 15.29 lakh complaints through channels including the DND application. Telecom operators deployed artificial intelligence systems that flagged billions of incoming calls and messages as suspected spam throughout the quarter.
articles.description: A total of 1,10,325 telecom resources, including mobile numbers, were barred from outgoing services for 15 days for the first violation

articles.headline: Students protest at SRFTI after filmmaker Ronny Sen denied entry
articles.title: Row erupts at SRFTI over denial of entry to filmmaker Ronny Sen
articles.summary: A campus dispute intensified at the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute after students accused the administration of blocking filmmaker Ronny Sen from conducting a workshop. Institute authorities stated that the Emmy-nominated director entered the premises unlawfully by scaling the perimeter wall. The confrontation follows ongoing student protests and the suspension of classes at the institute until December 11.
articles.description: SRFTI has been on the boil since September 27, when a clash broke out between a section of students and members of a right-wing organisation who were holding an event inside the institute’s auditorium

articles.headline: Indian apparel exports increase 20 percent in October
articles.title: Apparel exports surge 20% in October on currency depreciation, but volume growth remains subdued
articles.summary: Apparel exports from India grew 20.33 percent in dollar terms during October compared to the previous year, primarily driven by currency depreciation rather than shipment volume growth. Apparel Export Promotion Council Chairman A Sakthivel noted that the performance signals a gradual recovery in international demand. Major destinations for these ready-made garments continued to include the United States, the United Kingdom, and the United Arab Emirates.

articles.headline: Centre launches portal for mandatory online rice and paddy stock declaration
articles.title: Centre operationalises portal for online declaration of rice, paddy stock
articles.summary: The Union Food Ministry launched an online portal requiring all traders, retailers, wholesalers, and millers to declare their paddy and rice inventories weekly to prevent hoarding and control inflation. Entities failing to register or comply with stock limits will face penalties under the Essential Commodities Act. Retail rice inflation previously reached 8.25 percent in September, driven by reduced kharif paddy acreage and deficient rainfall.
articles.description: Units that are not registered on the portal or that violate stock limits will face action under Sections 6 and 7 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955

articles.headline: BMRCL to run 13 trains daily on Yellow Line from November 16
articles.title: Bengaluru Metro’s Yellow Line to run 13 trains daily from November 16; peak-hour frequency cut to 5.5 minutes
articles.summary: The Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited announced the addition of a new train to its service on the Yellow Line, bringing the daily operational total to 13 trains. This adjustment improves weekday peak-hour frequency from six minutes to 5.5 minutes while maintaining regular schedules during non-peak hours and weekends across the designated transport network.

articles.headline: Union Minister calls for coordinated anti-pollution measures across Delhi-NCR
articles.title: Air pollution does not recognise State boundaries, coordinated action required: Union Minister
articles.summary: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav urged regional authorities to enforce stricter pollution controls across the National Capital Region. Speaking at a review meeting, he stressed the importance of real-time monitoring, designated state officials, and automated camera surveillance to address severe air quality concerns and reduce vehicle emissions.
articles.description: Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav directed all agencies to move beyond planning and ensure rigorous, time-bound, and coordinated enforcement on the ground

articles.headline: Kerala High Court rules Tantri holds no ownership over deity assets
articles.title: Tantri does not have ownership of assets belonging to deity, says Kerala HC
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court determined that a temple Tantri possesses authority solely over religious rituals rather than legal ownership of deity assets. A division bench comprising Justices K.V. Jayakumar and Raja Vijayaraghavan V. dismissed a petition challenging a 2012 circular from the Travancore Devaswom Board, upholding statutory management frameworks for temple properties.
articles.description: The authority to perform and supervise religious ceremonies must be distinguished from the right to own or deal with the property of the deity, the court observes

articles.headline: Surging onion prices create severe financial distress for consumers in Kochi
articles.title: Surge in onion prices hits consumers hard
articles.summary: Retail markets in Kochi experienced a significant spike in onion prices, with shallots reaching up to ₹180 per kilogram due to low yields and supply shortages from Tamil Nadu. Local vendors reported that household budgets are strained by elevated costs for essential vegetables and provisions, which traders indicate are unlikely to stabilise until January.
articles.description: One kilogram of shallots costs up to ₹180 in the retail market in Kochi. The price of the essential item is around ₹50 per kg higher than it was the previous month, say traders.

articles.headline: Nigeria cautions citizens against travelling through Ethiopia's high-altitude international airport
articles.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
articles.summary: The Nigerian government has advised travellers, especially those with pre-existing medical issues, to exercise caution when transiting through Bole International Airport in Addis Ababa. The foreign ministry in Abuja reported that 16 Nigerians with underlying health problems died this year while passing through the high-altitude Ethiopian capital. Officials noted that lower oxygen levels at 2,334 metres above sea level pose serious risks to cardiovascular and respiratory health.
articles.description: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

articles.headline: Noel Tata cautions against listing Tata Sons to preserve operating philosophy
articles.title: Why to tinker with something that has delivered value for 150 years: Noel Tata
articles.summary: Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata has expressed opposition to listing Tata Sons, warning that shareholder interests could eventually supersede philanthropy and alter the group's governance model. Speaking in New Delhi, he emphasized that charity takes precedence over commerce within the 150-year-old conglomerate. While addressing calls for a public listing amid regulatory requirements from the Reserve Bank of India, he stressed the importance of maintaining institutional continuity and operational discipline.
articles.description: The trusts will work with regulators to find a solution to keep the Tata way as it is

articles.headline: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces occupy Palestinian-American’s home
articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces occupy Palestinian-American’s home
articles.description: Israeli forces occupied a Palestinian-American’s home in the occupied West Bank for 17 days.

articles.headline: NASA space probe Voyager 1 approaches milestone of one light-day distance
articles.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 to hit new space distance record of one light-day
articles.summary: NASA has announced that the Voyager 1 space probe will soon reach a distance of one light-day from Earth, having travelled at least 16 billion miles since its 1977 launch. Currently operating in interstellar space at approximately 36,000 miles per hour, the plutonium-powered craft continues to transmit daily scientific data alongside its twin, Voyager 2. Project manager Suzanne Dodd described the mission as a national treasure while noting ongoing communication efforts by a skeleton engineering team.
articles.description: The probe was launched in 1977, and it continues to relay space-related data back to a team of NASA scientists.

articles.headline: Stelco to recall 175 laid-off workers after Canadian government pressure
articles.title: Canada’s Stelco to recall 175 workers after government pressure
articles.summary: Canadian steelmaker Stelco has announced it will reinstate 175 laid-off workers at its Hamilton plant with retroactive pay following a dispute involving Industry Minister Melanie Joly and American owner Cleveland-Cliffs. The company stated that new customer agreements enabled finishing operations to restart on December 1. The layoffs had previously sparked friction over binding commitments made when Cleveland-Cliffs acquired Stelco in 2024, with officials citing market pressures and tariffs.
articles.description: Steelmaker promises back pay for workers whose layoffs its US owner blamed on tariffs, weak demand and imports.

articles.headline: US Democrats Schumer and Jeffries expected to retain congressional leadership roles
articles.title: Why US Democrats are expected to keep Schumer and Jeffries in power
articles.summary: Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer and House minority leader Hakeem Jeffries are widely expected to maintain their leadership positions as Democrats prepare to control both congressional chambers in January. Despite historic electoral gains, the prospect of continuity has sparked internal debate, with Senator Chris Van Hollen launching a formal challenge against Schumer. Critics argue the party requires new leadership to address shifting voter priorities, while supporters emphasize recent electoral successes and candidate recruitment.
articles.description: The prospect of keeping the Congressional leaders in power is exposing long-running tensions in the party.

articles.headline: Former civil servants urge Tamil Nadu chief minister to restore committee mandate
articles.title: Former civil servants urge CM Vijay to restore mandate of panel on Union-State relations
articles.summary: The Constitutional Conduct Group, comprising seventy-two former civil servants, has written an open letter urging Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to restore the original mandate of the High-Level Committee on Union-State Relations. The signatories criticized the decision to transfer report preparation to the State Law Commission, warning it will cause delays and institutional knowledge loss.
articles.description: Responding to the State government’s contention that the committee was non-statutory in nature, the group pointed out that the State Law Commission was also an executive body

articles.headline: Patriarch Ignatius Aphrem II visit escalates tensions between church factions
articles.title: Patriarch’s proposed visit to Manarcad church puts peace efforts on edge
articles.summary: The Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church warned that a potential visit by Patriarch Ignatius Aphrem II to the St. Mary's Jacobite Syrian Cathedral at Manarcad would aggravate ongoing factional disputes. Speaking on November 14, 2026, church representatives stated that visiting disputed properties violates court directives and undermines reconciliation efforts involving Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan.
articles.description: Orthodox Church says it will welcome resolution of issues through discussions between the Patriarch and the Catholicos, but the Patriarch visiting disputed churches will only make matters worse

articles.headline: India air passenger traffic declines 2.9% in April-September period
articles.title: Air passenger traffic takes a hit, declines 2.9% in April-September
articles.summary: Air passenger traffic in India contracted 2.9 percent between April and September 2026, driven by a 7.1 percent drop in international travel and a 1.9 percent fall in domestic travel, according to The Hindu. The decline is linked to West Asian conflict disruptions, surging aviation turbine fuel costs, and soaring airfares that reached a 43 percent increase by October, prompting airlines to cut capacity.
articles.description: The decline in passenger traffic has been accompanied by a fall in aircraft movements, pointing to a reduction in the number of flights operated by airlines

articles.headline: Landslip in Idukki kills 59-year-old cardamom farmer
articles.title: Landslip in Idukki kills cardamom farmer
articles.summary: A 59-year-old cardamom farmer named Purayidathil Benny was killed on November 14, 2026, by a major landslip at Kadamakkuzhi near Kattappana in Idukki. Officials reported that despite two weeks of no rainfall, large-scale mining and explosive use on the opposite side of the hill triggered the disaster, prompting a detailed inspection report for the district collector.
articles.description: Almost eight acres of cardamom plantation destroyed in the incident at Kadamakkuzhi, near Kattappana. Preliminary findings point to large-scale quarrying and mining on the hill’s opposite side, using explosives, as the likely trigger.

articles.headline: Karnataka private transport associations urge cap on electric cab fleet
articles.title: Private transport associations urge Karnataka government to cap Vietnamese electric taxi aggregator’s fleet
articles.summary: The Federation of Karnataka State Private Transport Associations asked Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar to limit Vietnamese conglomerate Vingroup's Green SM electric cab service to 100 vehicles in Bengaluru. The federation warned that corporate-backed low fares of around eight rupees per kilometer threaten the livelihoods of independent operators relying on bank loans for their vehicles.
articles.description: In a letter to Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, the Federation of Karnataka State Private Transport Associations sought immediate intervention to prevent what it described as unfair competition from the electric taxi fleet operated by Green SM

articles.headline: Kerala Sasthra Sahithya Parishad warns Mission Samudra threatens fishing livelihoods
articles.title: KSSP warns Mission Samudra threatens livelihoods of traditional fishermen
articles.summary: The Kerala Sasthra Sahithya Parishad urged the state government to reconsider Mission Samudra and the Maritime Board Amendment Bill, warning they could undermine traditional fishing livelihoods. General secretary V. Manoj Kumar and president C. Ramakrishnan stated the initiatives risk facilitating corporate control over coastal resources, eroding customary worker rights, and harming marine ecosystems across the state's marine fishing villages.
articles.description: Demands curbs on Maritime Board’s sweeping powers; calls for protection of coastal commons and fragile marine ecosystems

articles.headline: Karnataka organisations to launch year-long Constitution awareness campaign on November 26
articles.title: Year-long Constitution awareness campaign to begin on November 26
articles.summary: Dalit Sangharsha Samithigala Aikya Horata Chalana Samithi and Samvidhana Janandolana Samithi-Karnataka will launch a year-long awareness campaign titled Voice of Constitution, Voice of Public in Bengaluru. Former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah will inaugurate the initiative during Constitution Day celebrations. The programme aims to strengthen backward classes, minorities, and Dalits through study camps and discussions across all thirty-one districts of the state.

articles.headline: ED attaches properties worth ₹1.22 crore in KPSC recruitment scam
articles.title: KPSC ‘recruitment scam’: ED attaches properties worth ₹1.22 crore belonging to former chairman, member and IAS officer
articles.summary: The Directorate of Enforcement attached movable and immovable properties worth ₹1.22 crore belonging to former Karnataka Public Service Commission chairman Shivashankarappa Sahukar, member Geetha B.V. Shivamurthy, and IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar. The action follows an investigation alleging the officials abused their positions in a veterinary officer recruitment scam involving question paper leaks and bribes.
articles.description: The three officials allegedly abused their official positions to collect illegal gratification from candidates in exchange for assured selection through question paper leaks, supply of candidate-specific answer keys and manipulation of confidential marks during the preparation of the 1:3 eligibility list

articles.headline: Spain and England meet in final UEFA Nations League group match
articles.title: Spain vs England: UEFA Nations League – predictions, how to watch, teams
articles.summary: England will face Spain in the UEFA Nations League Group A3 finale at the Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid on November 15. Spain holds a 15-point lead and a 43-match unbeaten streak, while England sits second with 12 points. Manager Thomas Tuchel aims to halt Spain's run, though both teams have already secured quarterfinal qualification for March following previous September fixtures.
articles.description: Spain, who are unbeaten in their last 43 competitive meetings, host England in Madrid on Sunday.

articles.headline: Bihar police identify over one lakh suspected cybercrime mule accounts
articles.title: Bihar Police identify over one lakh mule accounts across 38 districts
articles.summary: The Bihar Police Cyber Unit has identified 1,09,475 bank accounts across all 38 districts holding ₹72.53 crore in suspected cybercrime funds, according to Inspector General Ranjit Kumar Mishra. Patna recorded the highest number of mule accounts at 14,644. Authorities plan to target these accounts through the upcoming Cyber Prahar 5.0 campaign to tackle rising financial fraud.
articles.description: A total of 47,659 cybercrime complaints were registered in Bihar, while 5,69,160 complaints were registered at the national level during September and October.

articles.headline: Green turtles move from ‘endangered’ to ‘least concern’ status
articles.title: Green turtles move from ‘endangered’ to ‘least concern’ status
articles.description: Green turtles have been reclassified from endangered to ‘least concern’ in global conservation rankings.

articles.headline: Indian railways to launch weekly train between Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya
articles.title: Indian Railways to connect Nepal’s Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya through weekly train service
articles.summary: Indian Railways will operate a weekly train service connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal with Ayodhya Cantt. in Uttar Pradesh, covering approximately 604 kilometres. According to the Ministry of Railways, the service aims to strengthen bilateral cultural ties by linking the two cities associated with the Ramayana tradition. The trains will run starting Saturday from Janakpur Dham and Monday from Ayodhya.
articles.description: The train will have stoppages at Jaynagar, Madhubani, Shisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, Gorakhpur, Basti, Mankapur, and Ayodhya Dham, besides its terminal stations

articles.headline: Himachal Pradesh approves financial assistance scheme for eligible women
articles.title: Himachal’s ₹1,500 allowance scheme: Who benefits and what’s the political impact? | Explained
articles.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government approved the Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna scheme during a cabinet meeting in Shimla chaired by Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu. Under the initiative, 3.50 lakh eligible women aged 18 to 59 will receive 1,500 rupees per month alongside 300 units of free electricity for beneficiary families across the state.
articles.description: What does the new Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna offer? Amid mounting debt concerns and Opposition criticism, will the government be able to ensure its smooth implementation?

articles.headline: India beat Bhutan 2-1 to reach SAFF Championship final
articles.title: India beat Bhutan 2-1 to enter SAFF Championship final
articles.summary: Defending champions India defeated Bhutan 2-1 on November 14, 2026, in Dhaka to enter the SAFF Championship final. P.V. Vishnu and Chinglensana Singh scored for India's under-23 reserve squad, while Tobden netted for Bhutan during a match that marked the historic debut of VAR in the tournament. India will face either Bangladesh or Pakistan in the November 17 final.
articles.description: The match marked the historic debut of the Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system in the SAFF Championship

articles.headline: Hungarian authorities uncover nearly $20m in cash during investigation into former minister
articles.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
articles.summary: Hungarian authorities recovered approximately twenty million dollars in cash hidden in farm buildings and buried in forests during a corruption investigation involving Miklós Seszták, a former minister under Viktor Orbán. The National Asset Recovery and Protection Office stated the funds were deposited into the Hungarian State Treasury following searches conducted as part of an anti-corruption drive led by Prime Minister Péter Magyar.
articles.description: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

articles.headline: National Centre for Seismology records four earthquakes across Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh
articles.title: Four earthquakes recorded in J-K, Ladakh
articles.summary: Four earthquakes ranging from 2.9 to 3.9 in magnitude struck Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh within an eleven-hour span, according to the National Centre for Seismology. Three tremors occurred in the Chenab Valley region of Jammu and Kashmir, including Kishtwar and Doda districts, while one struck Leh in Ladakh. Police confirmed there were no immediate reports of damage from the affected areas following the tremors.
articles.description: Of the four tremors, three were recorded in the Chenab Valley region of Jammu and Kashmir, while one struck Leh in the Union Territory of Ladakh, according to NCS updates shared on X

articles.headline: Karnataka deputy chief minister seeks inclusion of reservation law in Ninth Schedule
articles.title: Karnataka Deputy CM Parameshwara writes to Modi, Shah seeking inclusion of State’s SC/ST reservation law in Ninth Schedule on the lines of Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara wrote letters to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Amit Shah, and Virendra Kumar on November 12, 2026, requesting a constitutional amendment to place the State's Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes Reservation Act of 2022 into the Ninth Schedule. The appeal follows a High Court judgment striking down enhanced quotas that raised total reservations to 56 percent.
articles.description: Citing Tamil Nadu’s 69% reservation framework as a precedent, Mr. Parameshwara said Karnataka deserved equal consideration and a constitutional amendment to safeguard the rights and opportunities of SC/ST communities.

articles.headline: SIT searches Chennai property for remains of minor girl allegedly buried there
articles.title: SIT searches for remains of minor girl allegedly buried at ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani’s house
articles.summary: The Special Investigation Team probing child sexual abuse allegations against Gem Granites owner R. Veeramani conducted a search at his Royapettah residence in Chennai on November 14, 2026. Investigators deployed equipment to excavate the compound following a victim statement in a POCSO Act case indicating a minor girl was buried on the premises years ago.
articles.description: The search was based on a statement given by one of the victims in the sensational case in the court, that a minor girl was buried in the house of Veeramani a few years ago

articles.headline: South Sudan delays first national presidential and parliamentary elections until February
articles.title: South Sudan postpones first-ever national elections until February
articles.summary: The South Sudan election commission announced on November 14, 2026, that the country will postpone its first presidential and parliamentary elections to February 11 next year. The ongoing delay in the world's youngest nation comes amid rising ethnic and political tensions, ongoing violence, and questions regarding voter registration processes for millions of citizens lacking state-recognised identification.
articles.description: The vote, first expected in 2022, will now be held on February 11, according to the country's election commission.

articles.headline: Avian influenza confirmed in Cuddalore poultry farms prompting containment and culling
articles.title: Avian influenza confirmed in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore; over 1,500 chickens culled
articles.summary: The National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal confirmed H5N1 avian influenza in poultry samples from Kattiyankuppam village in Cuddalore district on November 13, 2026. District Collector Sibi Adhithya Senthil Kumar stated that rapid response teams have culled 1,550 birds across affected premises, implementing strict biosecurity protocols and deep burial procedures to contain the outbreak.
articles.description: On November 5, a carcass sample was despatched to NIHSAD Bhopal, which confirmed H5N1 on November 13

articles.headline: Microsoft reports full recovery of consumer products and services after disruption
articles.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after hourslong global outage
articles.summary: Microsoft confirmed that its consumer products and services fully recovered on November 13, 2026, while enterprise services showed sustained recovery. The technology giant stated it is actively monitoring email message backlogs and maintaining an extended observation period to ensure no additional mitigative actions are necessary following the severe system impact.
articles.description: The ‌technology giant said it was “monitoring the backlog of email messages ‌accrued during this ​event” before considering the issue with ⁠the enterprise services resolved.

articles.headline: Migrant caravan heads to US from Mexico after Democrats’ midterm win
articles.title: Migrant caravan heads to US from Mexico after Democrats’ midterm win
articles.description: A migrant caravan of more than a thousand people is heading towards the US border from southern Mexico.

articles.headline: Far-right Israeli ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben-Gvir leave lasting institutional legacy
articles.title: Netanyahu may fall, but his far-right legacy in Israel is going nowhere
articles.summary: Israeli finance minister Bezalel Smotrich and national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir have advanced hardline policies and reshaped their ministries since joining Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's 2022 coalition government. Both were sanctioned by Western countries in June 2025 due to their actions in the occupied West Bank and Gaza. Analysts note their respective bureaucratic and populist approaches will maintain their influence despite potential opposition governments.
articles.description: Israel’s far-right is accused of embedding a hardline agenda so deeply that reversing it may prove almost impossible.

articles.headline: France faces civil unrest and police scrutiny during nationwide demonstrations over living costs
articles.title: Riots in France: How anti-Government protests spiralled out of control
articles.summary: Nationwide protests over living costs and strained public services in France have sparked severe civil unrest, clashes, and thousands of arrests since September. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez defended the deployment of 70,000 security forces and acknowledged 161 internal investigations into officer violence. The unrest compounds challenges for President Emmanuel Macron as public finances remain strained ahead of the April presidential election.
articles.description: The French authorities’ heavy-handed response, including thousands of arrests, police beatings and curbs on marches, has added to the volatile mix of grievances fuelling an anti-Government groundswell that shows no sign of abating before next year’s presidential election

articles.headline: Karnataka government recommends including SC and ST reservation legislation in Ninth Schedule
articles.title: SC/ST quota enhancement: Karnataka recommends inclusion of law in 9th Schedule
articles.summary: The Karnataka government recommended that the central government place the legislation enhancing Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes reservations under the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution. Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma formally wrote to the Union Home Secretary regarding the 2022 act that increases SC reservations from 15 percent to 17 percent and ST quotas from 3 percent to 7 percent. The move follows political criticism from the Congress ahead of the assembly elections.
articles.description: Chief Secretary Vandita Sharma has written to the Home Secretary, Government of India

articles.headline: Qatar and Turkiye sign mutual defence pact to enhance regional security and cooperation
articles.title: Qatar and Turkiye sign a mutual defence pact: What do we know?
articles.summary: Qatar and Turkiye signed a mutual defence agreement following a meeting of the Supreme Strategic Committee in Istanbul chaired by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. The pact establishes a common position against external armed attacks and expands military exercises, defence manufacturing, and personnel training. Officials stated the agreement aims to build deterrence amid regional conflicts and shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.description: Analysts say the pact, agreed amid the US-Iran war, aims to deter attacks rather than build an offensive alliance.

articles.headline: Paraguay Senate removes President Santiago Pena from office
articles.title: How a bank collapse in Paraguay brought down the country’s President | Explained
articles.summary: Paraguay's Senate voted to remove President Santiago Pena from office and placed him under house arrest following impeachment proceedings initiated against him for misconduct. Vice-President Pedro Alliana was subsequently sworn in as interim President on November 7. Both politicians belong to the Colorado Party, which has remained the dominant political force in Paraguay since the 1940s.
articles.description: Millions of customers, abruptly, lost access to their savings accounts and pension payments after regulators seized the bank, setting off a sequence of events that culminated in a change of political leadership

articles.headline: South Sudan postpones its first national legislative and presidential elections until February
articles.title: South Sudan postpones first national elections until February
articles.summary: South Sudan postponed its inaugural national elections from December to February amid escalating ethnic and political conflicts. The electoral commission announced the new voting date of February 11, 2026, on social media as voter registration was scheduled to begin across 3,100 centres. The country has experienced deadly confrontations between President Salva Kiir's government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar.
articles.description: The legislative and presidential elections had been scheduled for December 22, after already being delayed several times. The United Nations had warned that a vote could set off widespread conflict

articles.headline: Hungarian investigators uncover nearly $20m in hidden cash during corruption inquiry
articles.title: Nearly $20m found in Hungary’s forests, buildings amid corruption probe
articles.summary: The National Asset Recovery and Protection Office recovered foreign and domestic currency during searches conducted on November 12 and 13 in Budapest and three other regions. The operation relates to an investigation of Miklos Sesztak, a former development minister accused of receiving millions in bribes. Prime Minister Peter Magyar stated the recovery demonstrates a definitive break from previous governance.
articles.description: An ex-minister faces a bribery probe as Hungary's new government investigates alleged corruption during Orban's rule.

articles.headline: Hungary seizes $18m cash tied to ex-Orban-era minister in probe
articles.title: Hungary seizes $18m cash tied to ex-Orban-era minister in probe
articles.description: Anti-corruption authorities in Hungary say they found around $18 million in hidden cash.

articles.headline: Security forces question suspects following Kulgam CRPF post attack
articles.title: J&K Police zero in on LeT operative, two foreigners in Kulgam CRPF attack
articles.summary: Authorities detained several suspects for questioning following a terrorist attack on a Central Reserve Police Force post in South Kashmir's Kulgam district on November 11, 2026. Security forces intensified cordon and search operations, established vehicle checkpoints, and deployed armoured vehicles across the district by November 13, 2026, to track down the responsible individuals.
articles.description: Lashkar-e-Taiba operative Mohammad Lateef Bha is wanted for two attacks in Anantnag and Kulgam last July that left a police officer and two workers from Chhattisgarh dead

articles.headline: CFTRI hosts national colloquium to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice
articles.title: CFTRI initiative aims to standardise micronutrient testing in fortified rice
articles.summary: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute organised a national colloquium in Mysuru on November 13, 2026, to address analytical challenges in food fortification. Experts deliberated on standardising testing for iron, vitamin B9 and vitamin B12 in fortified rice. Supported by the Gates Foundation through IIT Delhi, the initiative aims to reduce inter-laboratory variations and strengthen quality assurance across India, according to the institute.
articles.description: NutriQA-2026 focuses on reducing variations in laboratory results and strengthening quality assurance across the country

articles.headline: David Warner accuses Cricket Australia of a cover-up in ball-tampering investigation
articles.title: Warner accuses Cricket Australia of ‘cover-up’ in ball-tampering scandal
articles.summary: David Warner criticized Cricket Australia for a shoddy investigation regarding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal in Cape Town. His remarks follow autobiography claims by Usman Khawaja that the entire team knew about the plot. While current captain Pat Cummins dismissed the claims, Cricket Australia stated all players were given opportunities to come forward and rejected calls to reopen the probe.
articles.description: Former opener Warner was banned for a year for his involvement in the 2018 'Sandpapergate' incident in South Africa.

articles.headline: Jharkhand police book two men for forcing domestic help to level false charges
articles.title: Two booked for forcing Jharkhand Congress MLA’s minor domestic help to level ‘false’ rape charges against him
articles.summary: Jharkhand police registered a case against two men on November 14, 2026, for allegedly abducting and coercing a 15-year-old domestic help into making a false rape statement against Congress MLA Bhushan Bara. The complainant's grandfather filed the report in Simdega district. The legislator denied the allegations, claiming the case was fabricated by expelled party members.
articles.description: The girl told reporters that she was brought to Ranchi by the MLA's family in May on the promise of being enrolled in a school, but was instead made to do domestic work at his official residence

articles.headline: Indian commerce minister begins two-day visit to boost ties in Egypt
articles.title: Piyush Goyal in Egypt: Both sides to discuss increasing cooperation in infra, manufacturing, logistics
articles.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal arrives in Egypt on November 15, 2026, to co-chair the seventh session of the Joint Trade Committee alongside Minister Mohamed Farid Saleh. Accompanied by over 140 chief executive officers, Goyal will discuss bilateral trade, investment partnerships, and infrastructure cooperation. Bilateral merchandise trade between India and Egypt reached 5.04 billion dollars between April and September 2026.
articles.description: Egypt's strategic geographical location offers significant opportunities for Indian businesses to strengthen their presence in the country and access markets across Africa, the Middle East and Europe

articles.headline: Central Bureau of Investigation conducts searches across six states in Mahadev betting app case
articles.title: Mahadev betting app case: CBI searches in 6 States lead to recovery of digital devices, key documents
articles.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation executed searches at 33 locations across six states on November 14, 2026, recovering digital devices and documents related to the Mahadev online betting platform. Operations spanned Delhi, Mumbai, Nagpur, Amritsar, Bhopal, and Raipur based on disclosures from extradited promoter Sourabh Chandrakar. Officials stated that panel operators utilized mule bank accounts and hawala channels to transfer illegal profits abroad.
articles.description: The searches, carried out over the past few days, targeted premises in Delhi, Mumbai, Nagpur, Amritsar, Bhopal and Raipur, among others, linked to the betting platform's panel operators, they said.

articles.headline: Protesters heckle Hakeem Jeffries at Democratic conference
articles.title: Protesters heckle Hakeem Jeffries at Democratic conference
articles.description: US House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries faced repeated heckling at a Democratic conference in Denver.

articles.headline: Low pressure area forms over Bay of Bengal
articles.title: Low pressure area forms over Bay of Bengal, likely to intensify into cyclonic storm around Nov. 16
articles.summary: A low-pressure system formed over the Southeast Bay of Bengal on Friday and is expected to intensify into a cyclonic storm by the evening of November 16, according to the India Meteorological Department. Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority Managing Director Prakhar Jain warned fishermen against venturing into rough seas as authorities monitor the storm track.
articles.description: Dry weather is likely to prevail over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Yanam and Rayalaseema till November 16, with light to moderate rain likely at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Yanam on November 17

articles.headline: Student organisation condemns alleged sexual assault involving leader
articles.title: ABVP condemns sexual assault on Haldwani minor girl by its student leader and three others
articles.summary: The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad condemned the alleged sexual assault of a sixteen-year-old girl in Haldwani, Uttarakhand, on November 13, 2026. Police arrested four suspects, including local student leader Dheeraj Bisht, who were reportedly members of the ITI Gang. State Secretary Yashwant Panwar stated that the RSS-affiliated organisation will assist the victim to ensure speedy justice.
articles.description: In a statement, the RSS-affiliated student organisation said it viewed the incident with "utmost seriousness" and would make every possible effort to ensure justice for the victim

articles.headline: Kurumba community in Kerala struggles to preserve unwritten language
articles.title: Kurumba: a language and community fighting for visibility
articles.summary: Classified as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, the Kurumbas reside in the hilly forest regions of Attappady within Palakkad district. Members primarily communicate using Kurumba, an oral language lacking a script. Because outsiders do not speak this language, community members must learn Malayalam and other regional languages for external communication.
articles.description: The Kurumbas of Keralam are an Adivasi community with a population of only 2,719 as of 2024, who speak Kurumba, an oral language without a script; with the Census classifying languages with fewer than 10,000 speakers as ‘others’, the future of the language appears bleak

articles.headline: Mohamed Salah becomes Egypt all-time leading scorer during Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers
articles.title: Salah breaks Egypt scoring record, Tunisia lose to Libya in AFCON qualifier
articles.summary: Mohamed Salah scored twice to become Egypt leading scorer with 70 goals as his national team defeated Malawi 5-0 on Friday in Cairo. In other matches, Morocco crushed Niger 5-1 in Casablanca, Nigeria beat Tanzania 3-1 in Uyo, Libya defeated Tunisia 2-0 at home, and South Africa drew 2-2 with Kenya. The tournament features cohosts Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda.
articles.description: Salah scored twice to take his international tally to 70 ​and surpass former captain Hossam Hassan’s record.

articles.headline: Indian envoy Vinay Mohan Kwatra hits back at USCIRF over Sharjeel Imam
articles.title: No locus standi: Indian envoy hits back at USCIRF for remarks on Sharjeel Imam
articles.summary: Indian Ambassador Vinay Mohan Kwatra criticized the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom on November 13, 2026, telling the bipartisan agency to introspect on its prejudices after it flagged the detention of Sharjeel Imam. Kwatra stated the commission has no locus standi to judge Indian citizens' rights, while Imam remains booked under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act over allegations linked to the February 2020 Delhi riots.
articles.description: U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF) shared Sharjeel Imam’s profile on X, describing him as “a Muslim man detained in India for his religious freedom advocacy”

articles.headline: Kerala High Court rules police fully empowered to curb substance abuse in the city
articles.title: Police fully empowered to curb drugs and substance abuse in the city: Kerala High Court
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court stated that police possess full authority to enforce measures addressing drug and substance abuse across the state. A division bench comprising Justice Devan Ramachandran and Justice Basant Balaji considered a government appeal challenging a single-bench order regarding Kochi city police restrictions on hotel events. Legal representatives for Radisson Blu and the additional advocate general presented arguments during the proceedings.
articles.description: The court clarified that the directions issued by the Single Bench would not stand in the way of the police maintaining “requisite vigil and attention” to all activities about drug and substance abuse

articles.headline: Philippine court issues arrest warrant for jailed celebrity preacher Apollo Quiboloy
articles.title: Philippine court orders arrest of jailed, US-wanted celebrity preacher
articles.summary: A Philippine court issued an arrest warrant for detained celebrity preacher Apollo Quiboloy, who faces child sex trafficking charges in the United States. According to the Justice Department, the Makati Regional Trial Court acted following a formal extradition request made by Washington. Quiboloy denies all allegations against him, while currently remaining detained in Pasig without bail while on separate human trafficking trial proceedings.
articles.description: Palace denies timing of warrant is linked to Trump’s visit to Manila next week.

articles.headline: Rubio criticizes international criminal court in speech
articles.title: Rubio assails international court in speech to conservative legal group
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio criticized the International Criminal Court during an address to the Federalist Society in Washington on Friday, November 13, 2026. Rubio rejected international legal restraints on American actions, defended foreign policy decisions regarding Venezuela and Iran, and warned that Washington would respond forcefully if the Netherlands-based court pursued United States officials.
articles.description: The U.S., Mr. Rubio said, would not “submit to the sterile vision of radical judges or soulless global bureaucrats”

articles.headline: Kerala High Court directs Excise Commissioner to disclose underage alcohol consumption prevention steps
articles.title: Kerala HC directs Excise Commissioner to disclose steps taken to implement prohibitory measures to curb underage alcohol consumption
articles.summary: Justice A. Badharudeen directed the Kerala State Excise Commissioner to reveal actions taken for enforcing prohibitions against underage alcohol consumption. The petition filed by Vinod Vikraman Pillai of Kollam highlighted non-compliance with the Kerala Abkari Act regarding individuals under 23 years. The court noted recent fatal motor vehicle accidents involving minors and suggested the legislature consider lowering the juvenile age limit to 16 years.
articles.description: It was high time that the legislature considered appropriate amendments to the law to reduce the age of minority for juveniles and children in conflict with the law (CCL) to 16 years, the court opined

articles.headline: Oral GLP-1 medications offer new treatment options for diabetes and obesity
articles.title: Could one daily pill narrow the diabetes treatment gap in the Global South?
articles.summary: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist therapies are shifting from weekly injections to once-daily pills, potentially increasing global access to diabetes and obesity treatments. Oral options eliminate the need for cold-chain refrigeration, making distribution easier in emerging economies where high diabetes rates persist. Pakistan leads global prevalence at 31.4 percent, while medical experts highlight that these medications also improve cardiac, renal, and liver conditions.
articles.description: Globally, one in nine people lives with diabetes, as blockbuster injectable drugs begin making way for tablets instead.

articles.headline: Jesus Owono suspended for 12 matches following Jesus de Miguel's death
articles.title: Goalkeeper Owono handed 12-match ban after De Miguel death
articles.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono received a 12-match suspension from the Spanish football federation on Friday after a collision during a second division match against Tenerife resulted in the death of forward Jesus de Miguel. De Miguel died in the hospital on November 3 at age 30. Spanish police have opened an investigation, and Owono withdrew from international duty with Equatorial Guinea.
articles.description: Owono and De Miguel ⁠collided during a Spanish second-tier match between FC Andorra and ​Tenerife on November 2.

articles.headline: UK government's Be Ready preparedness campaign sparks surge in emergency supplies
articles.title: Paranoid or practical? Britain’s ‘Be Ready’ citizen campaign
articles.summary: The British government's new Be Ready campaign has driven a sharp increase in sales of emergency supplies across England and Wales since its October 22 launch. Led by the Cabinet Office and backed by Defence Secretary Wes Streeting, the initiative urges households to prepare for a 72-hour outage by stocking essentials like bottled water and tinned foods, though critics warn many cannot afford the reserves.
articles.description: People in England and Wales are rushing to buy tinned goods and wind-up radios - but what's it all for?

articles.headline: Katerina Siniakova secures record sixth year-end WTA No. 1 doubles ranking
articles.title: Katerina Siniakova clinches a record sixth year-end WTA No. 1 doubles finish
articles.summary: Katerina Siniakova secured her record sixth year-end finish as the top-ranked doubles player on the WTA Tour, holding the position for 209 weeks as of November 9, 2026. The Czech Republic native achieved a 54-8 match record this year, winning seven doubles titles, including the French and US Opens with partner Taylor Townsend, and received her trophy on Friday.

articles.headline: Indian student wins medal of excellence at international vocational competition
articles.title: How a mason’s son from Erode won a Medal of Excellence at WorldSkills 2026
articles.summary: M Surenthiran, a twenty-two-year-old civil engineering student from Erode, secured a Medal of Excellence in the plastering and drywall systems category at the forty-eighth WorldSkills Competition held in Shanghai, China, in September. The event brings together skilled youth globally, with India finishing tenth overall. Surenthiran prepared through district and national events funded by Tamil Nadu Skills and IndiaSkills.
articles.description: M Surenthiran has won a Medal of Excellence in Plastering and Drywall Systems at the 48th WorldSkills Competition in China. His exposure to construction work through his father, a mason, laid the foundation for this achievement

articles.headline: BJP dismisses Rahul Gandhi's phone tapping allegations as baseless and absurd
articles.title: Rahul Gandhi ‘habitual liar’: BJP on Congress leader’s phone tapping allegation
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized Lok Sabha opposition leader Rahul Gandhi on Friday after he alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is tapping his phone because it contains proof against him. BJP spokesperson Tuhin Sinha called Gandhi a habitual liar who engages in hit-and-run politics by making unsupported claims without providing evidence to authorities.
articles.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi alleged that he has proof of allegations against Narendra Modi on his phone, which is being “tapped by the Prime Minister”

articles.headline: Karnataka Chief Minister urges Centre for fair Bengaluru Metro cost sharing
articles.title: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar places Karnataka’s demands on stage with Prime Minister
articles.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar requested Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 13 to ensure a fairer financial partnership, expedite approvals for the Bengaluru Metro Pink and Red lines, and provide assistance for agricultural drought losses amounting to ₹62,482 crore. Speaking in Bengaluru, Shivakumar highlighted the state's economic contributions and sought central intervention regarding sugarcane pricing and Western Ghats environmental notifications.
articles.description: Demands included a fairer financial partnership over Bengaluru’s Namma Metro, clearance for Mekedatu project, scrapping Kasturirangan Report and immediate drought relief

articles.headline: Indian envoy slams US panel over remarks on Sharjeel Imam
articles.title: Indian envoy slams USCIRF over Sharjeel Imam remarks, says panel has 'no locus standi'
articles.summary: India's Ambassador to the United States Vinay Mohan Kwatra criticized the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom on November 14, 2026, stating the panel lacked standing to judge Indian citizens' rights after it described jailed activist Sharjeel Imam as a religious freedom advocate. Imam was arrested in January 2020 over Citizenship Amendment Act protests and later charged under anti-terror laws by Delhi Police.
articles.description: In a strongly worded post on X, Vinay Kwatra rejected the commission’s assessment, accusing it of making partisan and ill-informed observations about India’s commitment to religious freedom and equal rights

articles.headline: Former council chief urges Ladakh voters to choose development
articles.title: Should Ladakh be hub of agitation or development?: LAHDC-K’s former Chief Executive Councillor
articles.summary: Mohammad Jaffer Akhoon, former Chief Executive Councillor of the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council-Kargil, urged citizens on November 13, 2026, to prioritize regional development over protests as the Leh Apex Body continued an indefinite sit-in. Akhoon defended upcoming local elections and noted previous talks with the Ministry of Home Affairs on special status had made significant headway before protests intensified in Leh.
articles.description: As the sit-in protest in Leh continues, LAB co-chairman said the dharna will “intensify from November 14”

articles.headline: Former Nvidia CEO misled top lawyers about affair with Alice Huang
articles.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top lawyer on affair with Alice Huang: report
articles.summary: Former Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang misled company executives, including general counsel Tim Teter and marketing chief Alison Wagonfeld, regarding his affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, according to sources and internal messages reviewed by Reuters. Huang resigned on November 12, 2026, following the revelation of his relationships and subsequent board investigations into Alice Huang over potential spying suspicions.
articles.description: During the autumn of 2025 and in October 2026, in ‌response to press queries that drew some Nvidia leaders’ attention to his relationship with Megaspeed and Alice ​Huang, Jensen Huang at both times described their interactions as appropriate

articles.headline: SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight aiming for first round trip
articles.title: SpaceX launches 15th Starship flight with hopes of achieving first round trip
articles.summary: SpaceX launched its 15th uncrewed Starship spacecraft from South Texas on November 13, 2026, aiming to achieve the first successful orbital round trip and tower catch. While the upper stage reached orbit to deploy Starlink satellites, the Super Heavy booster deviated from its flight path and exploded over the Gulf of Mexico, marking a setback for Elon Musk's reusable rocket development program funded partly by NASA.
articles.description: Starship expected to descend from space after completing 14 orbits around Earth, setting up its debut catch landing for ​Saturday afternoon; the Super Heavy booster was diverted from its return flight path to a fixed point over the Gulf of Mexico before exploding a short distance ‌over the sea surface

articles.headline: International Criminal Court halts US troops probe in Afghanistan
articles.title: ICC stops probe into alleged crimes by US troops in Afghanistan
articles.summary: Judges at the International Criminal Court halted investigations into alleged crimes by American troops and ISIL in Afghanistan, citing evidence collection limitations. The ruling follows disputes with Washington over sanctions. The prosecutor appealed the decision while United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio previously vowed to dismantle the court, though the United States does not recognise its jurisdiction.
articles.description: The decision follows feuds between the United States and the Hague-based International Criminal Court.

articles.headline: International carriers object to Mumbai airport relocation proposal
articles.title: Why are international airlines being asked to shift to Navi Mumbai? | Explained
articles.summary: The International Air Transport Association wrote to the Ministry of Civil Aviation on September 9 objecting to Adani's Mumbai International Airport proposal. The plan requires shifting one-third of passenger and cargo movements to Navi Mumbai International Airport from October 1, 2026. The association opposed the forced relocation, which would cut 265 weekly international departures and affect 46 carriers.
articles.description: What has triggered the dispute between airport operator Adani Group and foreign carriers? How has Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stepped in to challenge the proposed shift?

articles.headline: Fear of diagnosis keeping people away from diabetes screening, finds IDF survey
articles.title: Fear of diagnosis keeping people away from diabetes screening, finds IDF survey
articles.description: While 84% of the 502 adults surveyed in India felt a diabetes risk check was worthwhile even if they were healthy, only 14% believed they were likely to develop Type 2 Diabetes

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh launches Amaravati Quantum Valley innovation blueprint
articles.title: From policy to talent: Amaravati Quantum Valley’s innovation blueprint
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh introduced a dedicated Quantum Policy to make Amaravati a top global quantum hub by 2030, combining research, commercial applications, and workforce training. Backed by Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the region attracted national agencies, global corporations, and startups while skilling over one hundred four thousand professionals to build a self-sustaining ecosystem.
articles.description: To put Amaravati among the top five global quantum hubs by 2030, competing alongside established centres in Chicago, Munich, Singapore, and Australia, Andhra Pradesh started with regulation

articles.headline: Justice Karnan’s incident brought judicial misconduct to the forefront
articles.title: Justice Karnan’s incident brought judicial misconduct to the forefront
articles.description: Two problems were raised in the aftermath — The need to revisit the process of selection/appointment of judges to constitutional courts, the need for an alternative to removal process to tackle judicial misconduct.

articles.headline: Amaravati Quantum Valley aims to build South Asia deep tech hub
articles.title: Inside Amaravati’s pioneering leap to quantum frontier
articles.summary: Engineers and policymakers in Amaravati are developing the Amaravati Quantum Valley to transform the region into South Asia premier deep tech hub. The initiative, led by Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu and supported by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, moves beyond importing foreign supercomputers to establish a self-sustaining hardware ecosystem and build quantum computers locally from the ground up.
articles.description: The first major test vision of building an indigenous premier deep tech hub arrives soon as an IBM Quantum System, already en route from the U.S., will be installed on February 3, 2027, at Amaravati Quantum Valley; homegrown breakthroughs are already emerging from Amaravati 1Q and Amaravati 1S labs, led by Q SHIVA and NAADA

articles.headline: Child sexual abuse: When boys’ voices break
articles.title: Child sexual abuse: When boys’ voices break
articles.description: Child sexual abuse of boys often goes unreported due to fear, shame, and stigma. Abhinay Deshpande reports from Telangana on families struggling to help their children recover and seek delayed justice

articles.headline: Federal Aviation Administration lifts nationwide ground stop after telecommunications outage
articles.title: FAA ground stop lifted: Why were US flights grounded, and what’s next?
articles.summary: The United States Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday after a telecommunications outage overloaded switches and routers at air traffic control centres. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that airspace reopened after four hours of disruption, which cancelled thousands of flights, stranded passengers, and prompted calls for significant air traffic control system upgrades.
articles.description: The FAA says nationwide ground stop disrupting thousands of US flights was caused by a telecommunications outage.

articles.headline: U.S. senators order Elon Musk to preserve records on Ukraine Starlink access
articles.title: Democratic U.S. senators order Musk to preserve records on Ukraine Starlink access
articles.summary: Democratic United States senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons instructed Elon Musk to preserve records regarding SpaceX satellite service restrictions in Ukraine. Ukrainian officials reported disruptions affecting military operations and drone communications. Lawmakers demanded written confirmation by November 30 and requested internal communications dating back to September 1 to address national security concerns involving critical infrastructure.
articles.description: Ukrainian forces say Starshield, the military-grade version of Starlink, is vital for frontline communications and ‌drone operations in their defense against Russian drone and missile attacks

articles.headline: Congress launches website to help voters check electoral roll deletions
articles.title: Congress launches website to help voters check SIR deletions, seek restoration
articles.summary: The Congress party launched a new website on November 13, 2026, enabling citizens to verify if their names were removed from electoral rolls during the special intensive revision and apply for restoration. Congress general secretary K.C. Venugopal announced the platform during the Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao campaign. Party workers will visit polling booths as Vote Rakshaks, and village-level meetings will be organized across India by December 15 to address alleged electoral irregularities.
articles.description: Announcing the initiative, Congress general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal said the website, Iamvoterakshak.in, would allow citizens to verify their names and formally protest against deletions by applying for restoration

articles.headline: Measles-associated deaths reach ten in the United States after two new fatalities
articles.title: Measles-associated deaths reach 10 in US after two more deaths reported
articles.summary: Pennsylvania and Wisconsin announced new measles-associated fatalities, bringing the United States total to ten deaths this year alongside more than 5,400 confirmed cases. A federal dispute emerged between state officials and United States Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. regarding how fatalities are classified. Infectious disease experts warn the ongoing outbreak threatens the nation's measles elimination status achieved in 2000.
articles.description: More than 5,400 confirmed measles cases have been recorded in the US to date this year.

articles.headline: Himachal Pradesh cabinet approves monthly financial assistance for women
articles.title: Himachal approves ₹1,500 monthly financial assistance for women
articles.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government approved the Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna on November 13, 2026, to provide ₹1,500 monthly to eligible women aged 18 to 59. Chaired by Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu in Shimla, the state cabinet decided that beneficiary families will also receive 300 units of free electricity. The initiative aims to fulfill a key pre-poll promise made by the Congress party during the 2022 Assembly election.
articles.description: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiary families will also receive 300 units of free electricity

articles.headline: 'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop
articles.title: 'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop
articles.description: Passengers throughout the country were impacted over what the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) describes as “safety and communication issues”.

articles.headline: India and Bangladesh to reschedule fifth round of consular dialogue
articles.title: India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will be held on a mutually convenient date, says Ministry of External Affairs
articles.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs announced on November 13, 2026, that the fifth round of the India-Bangladesh consular dialogue will occur on a mutually convenient date. Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that India seeks positive bilateral relations through existing mechanisms, including technical discussions on travel arrangements. The talks were postponed following diplomatic tensions surrounding the planned December return to Dhaka of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
articles.description: Diplomatic sources had indicated that the postponement of talks was because of the spike in tensions in view of the proposed return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh

articles.headline: Tanker collision leaves riverboat passengers clinging to railings
articles.title: Tanker collision leaves riverboat passengers clinging to railings
articles.description: Passengers were rescued after a tanker ship collided with a riverboat docked on the Mississippi River in New Orleans.

articles.headline: Singapore firm Megaspeed emerges as central player in global chip trade
articles.title: Megaspeed: Gaming company to chips linchpin
articles.summary: Singapore-based business Megaspeed, founded in 2023 by Chinese tech executive Alice Huang without prior semiconductor industry experience, rapidly became a crucial intermediary in the Asian chip trade. The firm purchased billions of dollars of technology from artificial intelligence chip manufacturer Nvidia Corporation, drawing intense scrutiny during the recent scandal that resulted in chief executive officer Jensen Huang stepping down.
articles.description: How Megaspeed, a little-known firm started by Alice Huang, became a linchpin in the chips trade

articles.headline: Former FAA official says ‘nobody really knows what is going on’
articles.title: Former FAA official says ‘nobody really knows what is going on’
articles.description: Former FAA safety team representative Kyle Bailey says grounding flights is the safest course of action.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate arrests Mahadev betting app co-owner Saurabh Chandrakar
articles.title: After CBI, ED arrests Mahadev betting app scam accused
articles.summary: The Directorate of Enforcement arrested Saurabh Chandrakar, co-owner of the illegal Mahadev Online Book betting syndicate, on Friday, November 13, 2026. A special court in Raipur subsequently remanded him to custody until November 19. According to investigators, Chandrakar and co-promoter Ravi Uppal operated the betting network from Dubai, generating massive earnings through franchise panels and laundering money via hawala channels.
articles.description: “In ED custody, Saurabh Chandrakar will be confronted with the statements of his associates, digital data and documents concerning his foreign entities and evidence of commission of offence of money laundering,” an ED official said

articles.headline: London police open sex offence investigation into comedian David Walliams
articles.title: UK police open sex offence probe into comedian and author David Walliams
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Police in London launched an investigation into non-recent serious sexual offences involving British comedian and author David Walliams following media reports accusing him of grooming and abuse. Walliams, who is 55 years old and denies all allegations, has been dropped by his literary agency and had several shows removed by the BBC. The probe follows investigative reports published by ITV News and The Guardian.
articles.description: The British TV personality, 55, denies sexual assault allegations, saying he has not broken the law.

articles.headline: Afghanistan completes a road to the Chinese border despite closure
articles.title: Afghanistan’s new road to China ends at a closed border
articles.summary: Afghanistan completed an unpaved road through the Wakhan Corridor to the Chinese border in Badakhshan province. Funded by the Afghan government at a cost of 365 million afghanis, the project aims to boost trade. However, Beijing has not opened the border or commented on the route, as China prioritizes strict regional security guarantees over commercial access due to ongoing threat concerns.
articles.description: Taliban government hopes its Wakhan Corridor road will open new trade routes and reduce reliance on Pakistan.

articles.headline: Ugandan army arrests senior generals amid presidential succession political tensions
articles.title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever
articles.summary: The Ugandan military detained at least a dozen senior officers during a crackdown led by army commander General Muhoozi Kainerugaba. The arrests, which include former intelligence chiefs, coincide with political divisions over the presidential succession of long-ruling President Yoweri Museveni. While officials defended the actions as anti-corruption measures, analysts argue the moves target officers opposing the general's ambitions.
articles.description: The 52-year-old general’s provocative posts and military threats have fuelled rumours of a dynastic succession.

articles.headline: Singapore investigates data firm linked to Nvidia chip export scandal
articles.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
articles.summary: Singapore authorities are investigating Megaspeed, a data centre company, over suspected fraudulent declarations regarding the export of high-end Nvidia chips. The probe follows concerns that the firm bypassed US export controls to supply Chinese companies. Nvidia founder Jensen Huang recently resigned following an affair with the former head of Megaspeed, Alice Huang, amid ongoing international scrutiny.
articles.description: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.

articles.headline: Rescue operations underway after tanker strikes cruise boat in New Orleans
articles.title: 32 passengers taken to hospital after tanker hits river cruise boat in US
articles.summary: A tanker collided with the American Heritage river cruise boat on the Mississippi River in New Orleans on Friday, causing the vessel to partially submerge. Emergency responders are currently conducting search-and-rescue operations for the 129 passengers on board. The cause of the collision remains unknown as authorities work to evacuate all guests and crew members.
articles.description: American Heritage paddleboat with 129 passengers on board is partially submerged on Mississippi River in New Orleans.

articles.headline: Deepti Sharma named ICC Women’s Player of the Month for October
articles.title: Deepti Sharma named ICC Women’s Player of the Month for October
articles.summary: Indian all-rounder Deepti Sharma received the International Cricket Council Women's Player of the Month award for October. The 29-year-old earned the honour after scoring 155 runs and taking seven wickets during India's undefeated series against Zimbabwe. Meanwhile, South African all-rounder Marco Jansen was selected as the ICC Men's Player of the Month for his performance.
articles.description: Deepti Sharma beat Bangladesh’s Sobhana Mostary and Australia’s Annabel Sutherland to claim the monthly honour

articles.headline: Pope Leo cheered on return to Peru city where he served as bishop
articles.title: Pope Leo cheered on return to Peru city where he served as bishop
articles.description: An estimated 1.5 million people have welcomed Pope Leo XIV back to the city in Peru where he once served as bishop.

articles.headline: Pope Leo returns to former diocese in Peru following cancer surgery
articles.title: Pope thanks crowds on emotional return to ‘second home’ in Peru’s Chiclayo
articles.summary: Pope Leo visited Chiclayo in Peru on Wednesday to thank supporters one month after undergoing lung cancer surgery. About 500,000 people attended Mass at Pampas de Pimentel, while a million lined the motorcade route. The Chicago-born pontiff, formerly known as Robert Francis Prevost, served as bishop there from 2015 to 2023. His 12-day South American tour concludes on Sunday after previous stops in Argentina and Uruguay.
articles.description: The Chicago-born pope was welcomed by huge crowds in the coastal city, on the final leg of his South America tour.

articles.headline: Gautam Gambhir expresses concern over batting collapses ahead of World Cup
articles.title: Gambhir concerned about India's batting collapses ahead of World Cup
articles.summary: India head coach Gautam Gambhir stated on Friday that he is worried about rapid batting collapses after his team was bowled out for 89 by New Zealand in the fourth ODI in South Africa. The heavy 244-run defeat follows a previous match where India struggled to chase 135. Gambhir highlighted challenges posed by New Zealand pacers Matt Henry and Kyle Jamieson, noting that dropped catches also contributed to the loss.
articles.description: “You’re always concerned when you get bundled out for 90-odd. Why won’t I be concerned? These are conditions which are going to be closest to what we might get during the World Cup,” Gambhir said

articles.headline: Paraguayan prosecutors file new criminal association charge against Santiago Pena
articles.title: Paraguay’s ex-president Pena faces new charge over Ueno bank collapse
articles.summary: Paraguayan prosecutors charged former president Santiago Pena with criminal association on Friday regarding the collapse of the digital bank Ueno. The 47-year-old politician, currently held in pretrial detention after being impeached last week, is accused of directing state funds to the firm. Investigators raided his official residence in Asuncion on Thursday, while three former central bank officials were also arrested.
articles.description: The criminal association charge over his alleged role in the collapse of the bank comes a week after his removal.

articles.headline: Nigeria completes 21-day Ebola contact monitoring period with zero infections
articles.title: Nigeria ends 21-day Ebola contact monitoring with no secondary transmission
articles.summary: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention announced on Friday that 62 contacts of a recent Ebola patient completed a 21-day monitoring period without falling ill. The index case involved a Swiss woman who travelled to Uganda and Nigeria before being evacuated to Switzerland, where she fully recovered. Authorities noted that an official end to the outbreak requires a 42-day countdown under World Health Organization protocols.
articles.description: None of the 62 contacts identified after the first case developed the disease, although 13 contacts reported fever.

articles.headline: Scott Bessent blames Commerce Department for failing to oversee Nvidia chip exports
articles.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
articles.summary: United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent criticized the Commerce Department led by Howard Lutnick for failing to properly oversee high-specification Nvidia chip exports. The controversy follows the ousting of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy whose firm faced smuggling investigations.
articles.description: Scott Bessent suggests Howard Lutnick’s commerce department failed to ban exports of Nvidia's chips to a firm thought to have links with China.

articles.headline: Clint Eastwood directed the sports film Invictus about Nelson Mandela
articles.title: Invictus again: South Africa’s cinematic rise to the Test summit
articles.summary: The cinematic film Invictus portrays how South African President Nelson Mandela utilized the 1995 Rugby World Cup to unite the nation following the end of apartheid. Directed by Clint Eastwood, the movie stars Morgan Freeman as Mandela and Matt Damon as Springboks captain Francois Pienaar, highlighting how sport served as a crucial tool for national reconciliation during a pivotal historical period.
articles.description: The Proteas, under Temba Bavuma and Shukri Conrad, hold both the World Test Championship and the No. 1 ranking — a position of affairs that seemed unimaginable in 2024 when a second-string side, a compromise because of the SA20’s emergence, was thrashed by New Zealand.

articles.headline: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority warns manufacturers over anti-cancer drug prices
articles.title: Comply with new prices of 137 anti-cancer drugs or face action, says regulator
articles.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority warned on Friday that manufacturers must comply with revised prices for 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs or face penal action. The price caps, which limit trade margins to 30 percent, took effect on November 9 following an October 17 gazette order. State drug controllers were instructed to monitor compliance across the supply chain and submit action reports by November 16.
articles.description: NPPA directs State drug controllers to strictly monitor prices

articles.headline: Migrants risk deadly route to Spain’s Canary Islands
articles.title: Migrants risk deadly route to Spain’s Canary Islands
articles.description: More than 7,400 migrants arrived in Spain’s Canary Islands during the first 10 days of November.

articles.headline: Bengaluru metro opens Pink Line elevated section amid mixed commuter reactions
articles.title: Bengaluru Pink Line begins operations today; BMRCL announces timings as commuters seek faster completion of underground section
articles.summary: The Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited launched train services on an elevated section between Kalena Agrahara and S.G. Palya following inauguration by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Commuters expressed mixed views regarding limited connectivity benefits while awaiting the underground section. Fares range from ten to thirty rupees, and the Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation introduced five dedicated feeder bus routes starting November 14 to enhance local transport integration.

articles.headline: T.N. Governor meets Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi
articles.title: T.N. Governor meets Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi

articles.headline: Senator Chris Van Hollen challenges Chuck Schumer for Democratic leadership
articles.title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
